user.title: Choose platform
user.description: Pick the Tuqiang site your account belongs to. Pick tuqiangol.com if you are not sure.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Sign in with the same account you use on the Tuqiang website. Read only, nothing is changed.

device_select.title: Choose devices
device_select.description: Tick the trackers you want forwarded to Traccar.

traccar_config.title: Traccar server
traccar_config.description: Enter the client endpoint of your Traccar server, for example http://192.168.1.10:5055. Port 5055, not the web port 8082. {count} device(s) selected.

data.heartbeat: Send a heartbeat when nothing changes (adds overlapping points)
data.send_battery: Send battery level and charging state

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in failed for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://
error.cannot_connect_traccar: No answer from that address, check port 5055 and reachability
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened, check the log

abort.already_configured: This account and server are already configured

init.title: Options
init.description: Changes reload the integration. The device list is fetched live from Tuqiang.

data.heartbeat: Send a heartbeat when nothing changes (adds overlapping points)
data.send_battery: Send battery level and charging state

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Tuqiang, keeping the previous device list
